heating_energy_definition: Annual archived boiler heating-energy indicator: sum of the daily BOILER:Boiler Heating Energy output, divided by 1e9 (GJ/year). The final archive-generation workflow renamed this output to Gas Consumption [J](Daily) in the distributed merged CSV; it is not a fuel or metered-gas quantity.
temperature_primary_definition: count of selected-zone daily mean air temperatures T < 24 C
cost_definition: unweighted sum of current component-specific cost rates (proxy)
carbon_definition: unweighted sum of current component-specific A1-A3 rates (proxy)
mcdm_method: min-max normalization on each horizon's Pareto front, then weighted-sum minimization

figure_definitions.correlation_2020_corrected: Pearson correlations across all 625 configurations in 2020
figure_definitions.pareto_mcdm_2020_corrected: All 2020 configurations, exact four-objective Pareto front, and min-max-normalized weighted-sum stakeholder selections
figure_definitions.below_24_horizons: Days with selected-zone daily-mean temperature below 24 C for the baseline, horizon-specific equal-weight selections, and horizon-specific minimum-indicator configurations
figure_definitions.temperature_threshold_sensitivity: Reference-solution sensitivity to upper thresholds 23, 24, 25, and 26 C
